LESSON: READING 15.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What emotions or feelings can we display when reading a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read texts accurately, with expressions and at the right speed
2. apply fluency strategies when reading a text
3. Appreciate the significance of poems in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 15.2.1 READING FLUENCY
This lesson teaches Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. read texts accurately, with expressions and at the right speed
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply fluency strategies when reading a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Appreciate the significance of poems in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency above.
2. Explain Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What emotions or feelings can we display when reading a text?
2. Why should we read a text at the right speed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read texts accurately, with expressions and at the right speed
2. apply fluency strategies when reading a text
3. Appreciate the significance of poems in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
